name: Commercial Kitchen Opening & Closing Checklist
primary_keyword: kitchen opening and closing checklist uk
secondary_keywords: sfbb opening and closing checks template
fsa daily diary opening closing pdf
search_intent: Head chefs, kitchen managers, and catering supervisors seeking an authoritative UK commercial kitchen opening and closing diary checklist covering chiller temperatures, handwash station verification, extraction canopy gas interlocks, safe food cooling (<8°C in 90 min), and night shutdown.

competitors.name: Food Standards Agency (FSA)
competitors.features: Static paper-based SFBB PDF diary pack that must be printed and filled manually.

competitors.name: SafetyCulture
competitors.features: SaaS inspection app requiring mobile app download and $24/user/mo plan.

competitors.name: High Speed Training
competitors.features: Informative training article with static printable PDF and course ads.

competitors.name: OnTheLine (Toast POS)
competitors.features: US-centric restaurant POS blog post citing 41°F rather than UK 8°C/5°C limits.

competitors.name: 7shifts
competitors.features: Restaurant scheduling software lead magnet requiring email submission.

gap_analysis.competitor_weaknesses: FSA SFBB paper diary gets grease-stained and damaged; SaaS alternatives lock digital features behind monthly subscriptions; US blogs cite FDA rules incompatible with UK EHO inspections.
our_differentiators: Interactive zero-login digital checklist with real-time temperature probe logger
Full SFBB opening and closing compliance with BS EN 1276 sanitiser timer
Strict 90-minute cooling rule and gas isolation night lockup verification
Instant CSV export and A4 formatted printout for EHO due diligence binders
